analyst_summary: Churchill Resources (CRI.V) holds the Hells Gate Antimony Project in Central Newfoundland — a real asset in a real mining jurisdiction at a genuinely extraordinary moment for antimony. China's 2024 export controls reset the strategic value of any western-source antimony project, and Newfoundland's jurisdiction risk is minimal. That is the bull case. The constraint is structural: at 316.7M shares outstanding, no compliant NI 43-101 resource estimate, and limited visibility into management track record or near-term catalysts, the per-share upside path is unclear. The company is worth watching closely: a maiden inferred resource or drill-program announcement would be the inflection point that moves this to BUY consideration. Without it, WATCH.
